name: eunomai
description: A Claude-only AI workspace: SDD/SPDD, living docs, safe controls, and trust-gated skills — packaged as a Claude Code plugin.

level.title: Safe-controls level
level.description: How much the guard asks: critical (only the co-author deny, force-push and risky deletes), standard (also git clean, reset --hard and reading secret files), strict (also lease pushes, any recursive delete, version bumps and word-level secret mentions).

mode.title: Safe-controls mode
mode.description: enforce: ask or deny as configured. report: decide nothing, only record what would have fired (see hooks/guard.mjs --hits).
